hooks.name: Dangerous Command Guard
hooks.description: Prompts for confirmation before destructive shell commands (rm -rf, force push, reset --hard, git clean, mkfs, dd) run.

action.command: python3 -c "import sys,json,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=(d.get('tool_input') or d.get('toolInput') or {}); cmd=c.get('command','') if isinstance(c,dict) else str(c); pats=[r'rm\s+-rf?\s+(/|~|\*|\.\s*$)', r'git\s+push\s+.*--force\b', r'git\s+push\s+.*-f\b', r'git\s+reset\s+--hard', r'git\s+clean\s+-[a-z]*f', r'\bmkfs\b', r'\bdd\s+if=', r':\s*>\s*/', r'chmod\s+-R\s+777\s+/']; hit=next((p for p in pats if re.search(p,cmd)),None); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'permissionDecision':'ask','permissionDecisionReason':'Potentially destructive command matched guard pattern; confirm before running.'}})) if hit else None; sys.exit(0)"
